Your bank`s margin on average loans to ROBOR 1M (wider marging = tightening; narrower margin = easing)

(the share of rejected loans and credit lines applications is expressed as the ratio between the volume of loans and credit lines requests from non-financial companies which have been rejected and the total volume of loans and credit lines applications)

Minimum advance (higher advance = tightening; lower advance = easing)
